message.content: Who exactly opposed the heliocentric model during Copernicus's lifetime? The Catholic Church placed *De Revolutionibus* on the Index of Forbidden Books in 1616, and Martin Luther was among the most vocal early critics of the heliocentric model. Did the Church condemn the book immediately upon publication? Nicolaus Copernicus faced opposition from religious authorities and fellow astronomers throughout the decades following his death. How did scholars reconcile biblical passages with his astronomical findings? Johannes Kepler, though ultimately a supporter, raised reservations about Copernicus's commitment to circular orbits. What a radical challenge this posed to the medieval worldview! Cardinal Nikolaus von Schönberg, though ultimately sympathetic, raised theological concerns about the model. How daring it was to publish such ideas in his final year! The debate he ignited proved to be one of the most consequential in the history of science. What an extraordinary legacy of controversy his work sparked!
